versions.changelog: Loopback default, token on every data endpoint, retention cap and --purge-data.

Initial release of owntracks-location skill for real-time phone location tracking.

- Receives OwnTracks HTTP webhooks and stores location data in SQLite.
- Supports named places with a CLI for adding, searching, and distance queries.
- Provides endpoints for latest location, history, and health checks.
- Allows agent queries like "where am I?" and remembering user-named locations.
- Requires OwnTracks app on phone, Node.js 22+, and LAN or Tailscale connectivity.
